newsitem.title: UK: Russia to make economy presentation abroad.
newsitem.headline: Russia to make economy presentation abroad.

text.p: High-ranking Russian officials will give a series of presentations on the country's economy to investors around the world, starting November 11, J.P. Morgan and SBC Warburg said on Friday.
Market analysts expect the officials to include discussions on Russia's long-awaited debut Eurobond.

"J.P. Morgan and SBC Warburg will be holding presentations on the economy of the Russian Federation, to be given by a senior delegation from the Ministry of Finance and the central bank of the Russian Federation (in Asia, Europe and the U.S.)," the banks said in a statement.
Morgan and SBC Warburg are the joint lead managers of the Eurobond, which was expected to be for up to $500 million with a five-year maturity.
The roadshow is likely to coincide with the return of an International Monetary Fund mission to Russia to discuss disbursing the latest tranche of the IMF's $10 billion loan to Russia.
The Russian central bank said on Thursday the mission was leaving after failing to reach agreement with Russian officials and would return in the first half of November.
It could also coincide with an operation for heart surgery on President Boris Yeltsin, which officials say is likely to take place in the second half of November.
"Presentations will begin in Asia and Europe during the week of November 11, ending in New York on November 20," the J.P. Morgan/SBC Warburg statement said.
